summary: Hemmelig is an open-source pastebin utility designed for sharing encrypted text and sensitive data securely between individuals or across distinct organisations. It provides a web-based interface for generating time-limited or view-limited secrets that self-destruct after reading. The platform functions as a dedicated repository for credentials and confidential snippets.
goodFor: It suits technical teams or individuals who need a self-hosted mechanism to transmit sensitive configuration values or passwords without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The project has a moderate maintenance tempo and overlaps with many alternative secret-sharing tools, meaning you should evaluate its active security updates against your threat model before adoption.
deployNotes: Deployment is typically handled via Docker, and you will usually need to configure persistent storage alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for secure transport.
